title: Brief
description: companion → plugin. One request, one conversation. Exactly one request is open per conversation at a time.

v.description: Protocol version. A shape change is a new version, never an edit of v1 in place.

reason.description: The platform's ring-reason vocabulary, carried through verbatim.

cause.description: The recorded human cause this request answers. The plugin uses the cause's author as the inbound sender.

deadline.description: After which the companion expires the request; the plugin need not enforce it.

sinceCursor.description: Exclusive lower bound; null for a conversation's first brief.

throughCursor.description: Inclusive upper bound, fixed when the request opened. A redelivered brief recomputes the same range.

resetSession.description: The platform forces a fresh harness session; the plugin must not resume.

delta.description: (sinceCursor, throughCursor], with the answering agent's OWN entries omitted — those arrive in the opener.

context.description: OPTIONAL — absent from an older companion. When present, the plugin places it on the system side of EVERY turn, fresh or resumed, so an edit lands on the next answer.

contextChanged.description: OPTIONAL — absent when nothing changed and from an older companion. The context levels a person changed since the agent last answered in this conversation; the plugin tells the model on the USER side of the turn, beside the reason, so it follows the current context and never blames itself for earlier messages the change contradicts.

closesAt.description: When the window closed; absent for a channel with none.

class.description: OPEN: window_closed today. A class the plugin does not know still has its instruction placed.

instruction.description: The platform's sentence the agent relays to the person — placed with the context, never dropped.

channelSend.description: OPTIONAL — absent whenever the channel sends and from an older companion. This conversation's channel will not send a free-form reply now (#3179); the plugin places the instruction on the SYSTEM side beside the context's missing parts, so the agent knows before it answers.

requestedAt.description: When the correspondent's handoff phrase landed.

class.description: OPEN: person_requested today. A class the plugin does not know still has its instruction placed.

instruction.description: The platform's sentence the agent relays to the person — placed with the context, never dropped.

personRequested.description: OPTIONAL — absent when nobody asked and from an older companion. The correspondent sent the binding's exact handoff phrase (#3190) and the organization's members were alerted; the plugin places the instruction on the SYSTEM side beside the context's missing parts.
